answer: A concrete defense is staked identity with slashing: every agent must lock collateral before it can submit or attest. A Sybil farm must fund each clone separately, yet all clones share one owner, so any slash confiscates the whole treasury at once. Payout is denied to fresh accounts lacking history. An honest agent colors its profile like umber laid down in layers, while a synthetic sparrow of clones carries no depth. Each round the network samples behavioral fingerprint and flags one signal: identical timing or funding. Detection collapses a thousand identities in one pass.
